newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market at standstill - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets near midday Friday were quiet, with no reported trades or bids, several market sources said.

Owners were seen pricing cattle at $104.00 to $105.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, up $2.00 to $3.00 from this week's top of $102.00 following higher CME live cattle futures Thursday and a rebound in southern Plains cattle prices, sources said.
Sales for the week were estimated near 80,000 head, below estimated showlists of 87,000, which could leave some cattle carried over to next week, they said.
